audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer frames Swain as a mobile dasher ('his mobility advantage doesn't exist', 'every trade he answers with a dash', 'dies mid-dash') — Swain has zero dashes, so Vex's fear-on-dash passive barely functions here. The content layer correctly calls him an immobile root-reliant mage.
audit.why: Swain's kit (Q Death's Hand, W Vision of Empire, E Nevermove, R Demonic Ascension) contains no dash. The lane is a range/poke war decided by dodging Nevermove, not an anti-mobility lane.
audit.corrected: Reframed tldr, tradeGood/Bad, ahead, loading, breakdowns, dos/donts around dodging Nevermove (12s rank 1), Q range mismatch (1200 vs 750), and R drain windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart: content win[] and packet chart say Vex all 7 rows; full phases[].side says Skill on all 7, and report[2] claims 'no permanent owner'.
audit.why: 55.72% WR over 1005 games, packet levelChart all Vex, content layer all Vex. The two layers must agree.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 full sides to Vex with matched why and rating edits; win[] already agrees so no content chart edits (no-op rule).

audit.whatIsWrong: Key interactions absent: Nevermove roots on the RETURN wave, not the outgoing one; Vex Q (1200) outranges Death's Hand (750); Demonic Ascension sustain vs short-trade burst; anti-heal vs Ravenous Flock never concretely timed; cooldowns field had no numbers.
audit.why: Riot text: E 'returns to Swain and roots'; Q 750 range vs Vex Q 1200; R 120s; E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries E 12s, R 120s, W 22s; dodge advice keyed to the return wave; anti-heal timing in ahead/loading.

audit.why: report[8] already includes early anti-heal into his sustain, covering the missing-interaction flag.

edits.before: An even poke war where his mobility advantage doesn't exist — trade marked rotations and let Gloom math grind the margins.
edits.after: He has no dash to fear, so your passive sleeps — win it as a pure poke war: dodge Nevermove's return and out-range Death's Hand.

edits.before: Win the marked-rotation war and convert R range into skirmish kills he can't match. Keep one eye on Demonic Ascension and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Win the poke war Nevermove can't answer and convert R range into skirmish kills he can't chase. Track his E — every whiff opens a 12-second lane.

edits.before: Swain wins by landing Demonic Ascension, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Swain wins by landing Nevermove's root into the full W-Q, then ramping Demonic Ascension while his passive heals the chip back.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Q the moment his E flies wide — Nevermove is 12s down at rank 1, and an immobile Swain with no root is just a target for your E-Q chunk.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Standing in Nevermove's returning wave — the root into W-Q bolts is his whole trade, and his passive heals whatever poke you paid for it.

edits.before: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Swain with marked-rotation threat, R every skirmish his team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex makes mobility a typo.
edits.after: Ahead, deny him fragments: zone him off the wave with E-Q, roam with R while Nevermove is down, and buy Grievous Wounds early so his passive can't heal it back.

edits.before: - Vex vs Swain - Track: Swain Demonic Ascension. - Mark before you trade — unmarked rotations are half rotations. - Demonic Ascension down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Vex vs Swain - Track: Swain Nevermove (E). - Sidestep the returning wave — the root is his only catch. - E down (12s) is your trade and roam window. - Grievous Wounds early blunts his drain.

edits.before: Mark and bolt — your trades are honest and your passive makes his mobility dishonest. Bank Gloom procs like currency.
edits.after: No dashes here, so your passive sleeps — win with range: Q his last-hits and step up hard for the 12s Nevermove is down.

edits.before: Luden's onward, hunt the skirmishes: R into river fights, fear the convergence, and reset off whatever dies. Your range is wherever the missile reaches.
edits.after: Luden's onward, keep trades short — his R drains through long fights. R into river skirmishes while his E is down; he can't chase the reset or flee it.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nevermove runs 12s at rank 1 — his only catch; a whiff is a free trade or roam window. - Demonic Ascension is 120s: disengage when it starts, commit when it's down. - Vision of Empire is 22s early — his zone poke stays rare.

edits.before: Best wave: an E-Q cleared push that crashes with Doom glowing — your shove doubles as a fear-loaded threat display. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with W down and no glow — the anti-dive mage with no anti or dive left. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
edits.after: Best wave: a slow push you crash while Vision of Empire is on its 22s cooldown — he clears slowly early and bleeds plates. Worst wave: a freeze he pokes Death's Hand through — he stacks Soul Fragments off every step-up you make. Crash and roam with R while Nevermove is down; he can neither follow the play nor punish the wave fast enough.

edits.after: Carry by out-ranging the anchor: Swain wants 650-range drain fights — poke him below all-in HP before they start and R the flank.

edits.before: You are the engage tax: their dive comp feeds your fears, your R feeds on their commitments, and the carry they sent dies mid-dash, repeatedly.
edits.after: Bait Nevermove before you commit — it's his one pick tool. Burst in windows, never sit inside the R drain zone, and keep Grievous Wounds applied.
